answer: Each epoch, every identity must answer a fresh reasoning challenge drawn from a sable pool no one can preview, witnessed by a random grove of seven independent verifiers who each re-derive the solution. An honest agent answers once, in about ten minutes, and its lotus of past verified answers grows one petal per epoch. A fake cannot copy or precompute: each answer is bound to its own verifier grove and a narrow time window, so an attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand distinct live solutions at once, and the flood cost rises linearly with every fake.
